findings.title: WordPress user enumeration (REST API)
findings.detail: Usernames exposed via /wp-json/wp/v2/users: admin, sync_sapphire, seo
findings.fix: Restrict the users endpoint (security plugin, or rest_endpoints filter unsetting /wp/v2/users for unauthenticated users).

findings.title: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
findings.fix: Add: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains

findings.title: Clickjacking protection
findings.fix: Add X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN (or CSP frame-ancestors 'self').

findings.title: Time to first byte (avg of 3)
findings.detail: 2756 ms (samples: 3379, 2695, 2194 ms) — measured from the scanner's location
findings.fix: Enable full-page caching (LiteSpeed Cache / WP Rocket / Laravel response cache), OPcache, a CDN, and check slow DB queries.

findings.title: XML-RPC enabled
findings.detail: /xmlrpc.php is enabled (brute-force amplification / pingback DDoS vector)
findings.fix: Disable XML-RPC (add_filter('xmlrpc_enabled', '__return_false') or block /xmlrpc.php at the server) unless Jetpack/app needs it.

findings.title: Legacy TLS 1.0/1.1 disabled
findings.fix: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1 (nginx: ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; Apache: SSLProtocol -all +TLSv1.2 +TLSv1.3).

findings.title: WordPress author enumeration (?author=1)
findings.fix: Block ?author= scans via security plugin or rewrite rule.

findings.title: readme.html present
findings.fix: Delete readme.html and license.txt from the web root.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.fix: Add: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.fix: Add: Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.fix: Add: Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()

findings.title: Server / framework version disclosure
findings.fix: Hide versions: nginx server_tokens off; Apache ServerTokens Prod + ServerSignature Off; PHP expose_php = Off.

findings.title: DMARC policy
findings.fix: Move from p=none to p=quarantine/reject once reports look clean.

findings.title: HTML document size
findings.fix: Reduce inline CSS/JS/SVG, page-builder bloat and inline base64 images.

findings.title: Page resources
findings.fix: Combine/defer scripts and remove unused plugins.

findings.title: Detected technologies
findings.detail: WordPress, Elementor, PHP, React, Bootstrap, Cloudflare, Google Analytics / GTM, reCAPTCHA | generator: WordPress 7.1.4

findings.title: Default login URL exposed
findings.fix: Add login rate-limiting, 2FA, and optionally move or restrict wp-login.php.

findings.title: WordPress plugins/themes visible in source
findings.detail: Plugins: elementor@4.3.6, jeg-elementor-kit@3.3.0, metform@4.3.4, elementskit-lite@4.1.0, brave-popup-builder | Themes: hello-elementor
findings.fix: Keep every plugin/theme updated; run the wpscan tool (with an API token) for CVE matching.

findings.title: Third-party scripts without SRI

findings.fix: Add integrity="sha384-…" crossorigin="anonymous" to static CDN scripts.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
findings.fix: Optional: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
